text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a dramatic oversized black shag outer layer with a rounded cocoon/poncho-like silhouette that engulfs the shoulders, torso, and arms, falling to around the lower knee/upper calf and exposing bare legs below. The surface is densely covered in long, irregular dangling strands, looped cords, and fringe-like textures, creating a heavy tactile, all-black feathered or raffia-like effect with uneven movement at the hem. A black high-neck layer is visible at the throat beneath the outerwear, continuing the monochrome upper-body styling. The head is covered by a close black hood or cap that frames the face and hides the hair, paired with large dark wraparound/square sunglasses for a concealed, futuristic mood. In one hand, the model carries a small structured black handbag with a short handle and visible metallic hardware. The footwear contrasts the dark look: low Mary Jane-style flats or slippers with rounded toes, dark navy/black edging, pale yellow-green front panels, and a strap across the instep, worn with bare legs. The overall styling is protective, sculptural, and textural, with an enveloping black upper silhouette balanced by graphic color-block flat shoes.
key_elements: dense long fringe and looped cord texture
black hood or close head covering
small structured black handbag with metal hardware
pale yellow-green and dark Mary Jane-style flats
uncertainty_notes: Exact material of the shaggy outerwear is not visually confirmable
Underlying garment is mostly hidden except for the black high neckline
Footwear construction appears Mary Jane-like but precise closure details are not visible
